name: Good Day Choco Chill
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Egg, Vanaspati, Interesterified Vegetable Fat, Humectant (422), Dextrose, Refined Palmolein Oil, Liquid Glucose, Cocoa Solids (2.1%), High Maltose Syrup, Fructooligosaccharides, Colours (150d, 150c, 102, 122, 132, 133), Cake Gel [Emulsifiers (471, 477, 470(i)) & Humectants (1520, 422)], Raising Agents (341(i), 500(ii), 450(vii) & 450(i)), Nature Identical (Chocolate) & Artificial (Creamy Vanilla) Flavouring Substances, Invert Syrup, Iodized Salt, Preservatives (202 & 282), Acidity Regulator (330), Baking Powder, Emulsifier (475) and Stabilizer (415). Contains Wheat & Egg.
